summary: AWS credentials (access key, secret key, optional STS token) are injected as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN; quote Boolean EC2 tag values, and do not attach an AWS credential if you want to use IAM role credentials.
